title: Kooky Welsh Refried Beans Bubble And Squeak
description: A fermented, gooey, post-workout Welsh dish featuring refried beans, namul-blanch-season, and whole30-friendly ingredients, formed into a bubble and squeak cake.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the coconut oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the blanched and seasoned namul and cook until heated through.
In a large bowl, combine the fermented refried beans, cooked namul mixture, and broken cauliflower florets.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 5 minutes before serving.
